title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as B = (2a m v0) / (q (a² + b²)).

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as E = (2b m v0²) / (q a²).

title: Circular motion geometry
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the radius R to point P's coordinates using the geometry of the circular path, such as (a - R)² + b² = R².

title: Lorentz force centripetal
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the Lorentz force law for circular motion, stating q v0 B = m v0² / R.

title: Electric motion kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up the kinematic equations for the electric field case: a = v0 t for horizontal motion and b = (1/2) a_m t² for vertical motion.

title: Newton's second law
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law to relate the electric force and acceleration: qE = m a_m.

title: Sign of charge
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly uses the sign of the charge in the force equations, forgetting it is negative and the magnetic field is inward, leading to an incorrect force direction or radius formula.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student includes correct SI units (Tesla, N/C) with the final answers or demonstrates dimensional analysis.
